summary: Drain unblock 2026-10-30: reenter the stale-worker failed/ entries of brief tasks-aisdlc-1108-plus-18 and the six planner-routed PRs from their existing worktrees

options.description: Reenter each listed entry from its existing worktree with the named notes, one per tick (recommended: keeps developer output, sanctioned reenter path)
Dequeue, remove worktrees and enqueue fresh (loses 13 developer passes)
Leave failed/ as is and wait for the operator

body:
Problem. The queue holds only tail entries (AISDLC-1076, 1083, 1087, 772, 781) whose `after` predecessors (1072, 1086, 779, 671) sit in failed/ as stale-worker manifests from the 2026-10-28 stall (manifest + diagnostic, no verdict, developer output still in .worktrees/). Nothing is claimable, zero inflight, 18 PRs open. The 17:25Z chat ruling to reenter them was not board authority, so dispatch did not act. This record is that authority (class (a): reversible, small blast radius, no governance control touched). Operator present 2026-10-30 23:30Z and asked why nothing is dispatched.

Scope. Dispatch runs `cli-dispatch reenter <id> --decision DEC-0281`, one per tick, from the EXISTING worktree, never wiping it:
- Stale-worker tasks of the brief: AISDLC-778 (resume from 118448467), 779, 783, 787, 1072, 1086, 1106, 1108, 1110, 1112, 1119; note "Developer pass required".
- Six routed PRs: #2178 (AISDLC-1110) keep-both conflict in pipeline-cli/src/hierarchy/dispatch-loop.test.ts (main canary block first, branch restarts block second); #2111 (AISDLC-655.3) in pipeline-cli/src/usage/replay-run.ts keep the branch spawn() closure wrapped in main's withTimeout(..., timeoutMs) with timeout: timeoutMs, drop REVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS; #2064 (AISDLC-1072) and #2168 (AISDLC-1119) Developer pass required; #2139 (AISDLC-1111) and #2171 (AISDLC-585) resume straight to verification and review (their only failures were the main-red sync-plugin-runtime-deps test fixed by #2143 and the leaked executor-start tests fixed by AISDLC-1112).
- Drop AISDLC-772 from queue/ (dispatchable:false since #2164) and retire AISDLC-1103 from failed/ (already completed).
A conflict outside the named file stops that item and sends the planner the file list.
